content.text: {"knowledge_entries":[{"intended_agents":["role_educator"],"name":"Planetary Models and Spectroscope Displays in Planetary and Spectroscope Zone","source_object_ids":["object_001","object_004","object_007","object_010","object_013"],"tag":"astronomy","text":"In the Planetary and Spectroscope Zone located around coordinates (-2.5, -2.8), visitors find detailed planet models (e.g., object_001, object_007, object_013) and spectroscopes (object_004, object_010). These exhibits illustrate planetary characteristics and the analysis of light spectra from celestial bodies, supporting learning about planetary science and spectroscopy."},{"intended_agents":["role_educator"],"name":"Educational Role of Planetary Science Exhibits","source_object_ids":["object_001","object_007","object_013"],"tag":"planetary_science","text":"Planet models such as object_001, object_007, and object_013 serve as educational tools to demonstrate planetary features and compositions. Positioned in the Planetary and Spectroscope Zone, these models help visitors understand the diversity and science of planets."},{"intended_agents":["role_educator"],"name":"Spectroscopy Exhibits for Light Spectrum Analysis","source_object_ids":["object_004","object_010"],"tag":"spectroscopy","text":"Spectroscopes displayed as object_004 and object_010 in the Planetary and Spectroscope Zone enable visitors to explore how light spectra reveal information about planetary atmospheres and compositions, enhancing understanding of celestial light analysis."},{"intended_agents":["role_educator","role_meteorite_specialist","role_orbit_guide"],"name":"Educational Focus Across Zones","source_object_ids":["object_001","object_004","object_007","object_010","object_013"],"tag":"education","text":"The gallery's educational design integrates exhibits like planet models and spectroscopes in the Planetary and Spectroscope Zone to engage visitors in astronomy concepts, fostering learning through clear, labeled displays and interactive explanations."},{"intended_agents":["role_meteorite_specialist"],"name":"Meteorite Displays and Star Maps in Meteorite and Star Map Zone","source_object_ids":["object_002","object_005","object_008","object_011","object_014"],"tag":"meteorites","text":"Located near (-2.0, -2.0), the Meteorite and Star Map Zone features meteorite displays (object_002, object_008, object_014) and star maps (object_005, object_011). These exhibits educate visitors about extraterrestrial materials and celestial navigation."},{"intended_agents":["role_meteorite_specialist"],"name":"Geological Insights from Meteorite Exhibits","source_object_ids":["object_002","object_008","object_014"],"tag":"geology","text":"Meteorite displays such as object_002, object_008, and object_014 provide geological information about space rocks, their origins, and significance, helping visitors understand the composition and history of extraterrestrial materials."},{"intended_agents":["role_meteorite_specialist"],"name":"Star Maps for Celestial Navigation Education","source_object_ids":["object_005","object_011"],"tag":"star_maps","text":"Star maps displayed as object_005 and object_011 in the Meteorite and Star Map Zone guide visitors in understanding star positions and navigation techniques, supporting knowledge about the night sky and astronomical mapping."},{"intended_agents":["role_meteorite_specialist","role_educator","role_orbit_guide"],"name":"Educational Role of Meteorite and Star Map Zone","source_object_ids":["object_002","object_005","object_008","object_011","object_014"],"tag":"education","text":"This zone combines meteorite and star map exhibits to educate visitors on both the physical nature of meteorites and the use of star charts, enriching the gallery's comprehensive astronomy education."},{"intended_agents":["role_orbit_guide"],"name":"Orbit Simulators and Telescopes in Orbit Simulator and Telescope Zone","source_object_ids":["object_003","object_006","object_009","object_012","object_015"],"tag":"orbital_mechanics","text":"The Orbit Simulator and Telescope Zone, centered near (2.0, -2.0), includes orbit simulators (object_003, object_009, object_015) and telescopes (object_006, object_012). These interactive exhibits teach visitors about orbital mechanics and observational astronomy."},{"intended_agents":["role_orbit_guide"],"name":"Telescopes for Observational Astronomy","source_object_ids":["object_006","object_012"],"tag":"telescopes","text":"Telescopes such as object_006 and object_012 provide hands-on experience for visitors to learn about astronomical observation techniques, enhancing understanding of how celestial bodies are studied."},{"intended_agents":["role_orbit_guide"],"name":"Interactive Exhibits Supporting Astronomy Learning","source_object_ids":["object_003","object_006","object_009","object_012","object_015"],"tag":"interactive_exhibits","text":"Interactive orbit simulators and telescopes engage visitors in active learning about orbital paths and telescope operation, making complex astronomy concepts accessible and experiential within the gallery."},{"intended_agents":["role_orbit_guide","role_educator","role_meteorite_specialist"],"name":"Educational Integration in Orbit and Telescope Zone","source_object_ids":["object_003","object_006","object_009","object_012","object_015"],"tag":"education","text":"This zone's interactive orbit simulators and telescopes are designed to educate visitors on orbital dynamics and observational methods, complementing other zones to provide a holistic astronomy learning environment."}]}
